Method of Attack: Ransomware infection distributed by Neutrino exploit kit using DLL files
Encryption of files using AES-256 (CrypMIC) and RSA/RC4 (CryptXXX)
Malvertising and compromised websites as attack vectors
Retrieval of encryption keys and ransom notes from C&C servers
Information theft and system information sent to C&C
Impacted Systems: Windows systems with drives D to Z, %USERPROFILE%, removable and mapped network drives (CrypMIC)
Windows systems with drives B to Z, removable and network drives (CryptXXX)
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note files: README.TXT, README.HTML, README.BMP (CrypMIC); !README.HTML, !README.BMP (CryptXXX)
Payment server login screens with distinct UI differences
Personal ID formats in ransom notes: 4 groups of 8 hex characters separated by colons (CrypMIC), 12 hex characters (CryptXXX)
